assertion_analysis.failure_condition: A sweep returns an error or a failed dispatch; these prevent a broken sweep from masquerading as zero compositions.
The fixture is not scoring, _resume does not reach the callback, or the callback occurs without the launch marker and before-head-stamp ordering; these independently establish the reproduced window.
Restore use of the pre-resume snapshot for guards; the stub composes the superseded git head and the empty-list assertion fails. Recorded negative control reports this failure.
Remove current-process refusal or fail to refresh the pointer after classification; the known live os.getpid() then permits a composition, or omits the refusal report.

The shared reader misses the fixture acknowledgement, the dispatcher ignores it, expires it early, or continues withholding at expiry; the composition list and refusal assertion fail on the corresponding boundary.

Ignore the superseded-head state before delivery, or continue withholding after the new git commit and fresh completed manifest; output is compared to an independently read git HEAD, not a dispatcher-produced expected value.

Remove the attempt_kind guard and review the baseline manifest, or restore the requirement for a resume stamp even when a baseline generation exists; the before/after composition assertions fail respectively.

Restore whole-pointer replacement: backend, brief and nested lane equal the competing stored values, while manifest_commits is missing; these are input-preservation tests that can fail, not self-comparisons computed by the dispatcher.
